title: Keep a stronger ordinary active route and its physical resource boundary
statement: The same-bath driven-mean comparator pays finite-U Gibbs inputs, contiguous-time-average covariance and forced initial moments. body: This is one hidden quartic against zero, not all-quartic tomography or unknown K. Each plan has its own fixed statistical guarantee, not a joint adaptive selection certificate. A K3 coarse-gap failure is not a full-distribution impossibility. Same-bath ordinary driven mean beats the calibrated passive duration; stronger drive pays peak, displacement and recoverable loading energy, which is not irreversible work. Native model time is not lab seconds. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
